description: This file contains functions for managing and inspecting gateway processes, including reading process arguments on different platforms, discovering listening PIDs on specific ports, and signaling processes. It is platform-aware and interacts with system commands and process information to identify and verify gateway processes.

methods.name: extractWindowsCommandLine
methods.description: Extracts the command line string from raw Windows process info output.

methods.name: readWindowsProcessArgsViaPowerShell
methods.description: Reads process arguments on Windows using PowerShell CIM command.

methods.name: readWindowsProcessArgsViaWmic
methods.description: Reads process arguments on Windows using WMIC command.

methods.name: readWindowsListeningPidsViaPowerShell
methods.description: Gets listening PIDs on Windows via PowerShell for a specific port.

methods.name: readWindowsListeningPidsViaNetstat
methods.description: Gets listening PIDs on Windows via netstat for a specific port.

methods.name: readWindowsListeningPidsOnPortSync
methods.description: Attempts to get listening PIDs on Windows via PowerShell, falls back to netstat.

methods.name: readGatewayProcessArgsSync
methods.description: Reads process arguments synchronously based on platform (Linux, macOS, Windows).

methods.name: signalVerifiedGatewayPidSync
methods.description: Signals a verified gateway process with specified signal after validation.

methods.name: findVerifiedGatewayListenerPidsOnPortSync
methods.description: Finds and verifies gateway listener PIDs on a given port.

methods.name: formatGatewayPidList
methods.description: Formats a list of PIDs into a comma-separated string.
